text: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans; and then he ate some radishes; And then, feeling rather sick, he went to look for some parsley.
title: Peter Rabbit — Greedy Eating in Mr. McGregor's Garden
director_note: I kept Peter low in the frame so his eating and tummy-rub read as grounded comedy, and let his walk to parsley carry him across the garden with a clear, earned exit. The added vegetables sit close to him, making the greed feel tangible before the sickness turns him away.
